title: Cap. VIII open: adversaries' arguments proposed and solved
pass_a_gloss: Chapter VIII. The arguments of the adversaries are proposed and solved. Let us now approach the arguments of the adversaries, who contend that those sins with which the reprobate are foresighted as about to depart from life were the meritorious and moving cause of Divine reprobation.
pass_b_english: Chapter VIII — the adversaries' arguments proposed and solved. We turn now to their arguments: they contend that the sins with which the reprobate are foresighted as about to leave life were the meritorious and moving cause of divine reprobation.
source_text: Cap. VIII. Argumenta adversariorum proponuntur et solvuntur. Accedamus jam ad argumenta adversariorum, qui contendunt peccata ea cum quibus reprobi praevidentur vita decessuri, fuisse causam meritoriam et motivam reprobationis Divinae.
